tos.title: Before you start
tos.p1: The app is free and has no ads. Microphone sound is processed on the device only and is never sent anywhere.
tos.p2: Everything you add yourself — recordings, tabs, lyrics — stays on your device and is your responsibility. Only add things you have the rights to.

hc.start.name: How Melete works
hc.start.what: A practice journal and musician’s tools. Data stays on this device.
hc.start.1: “Practice” — the week, goal and league; “Start practice” — a session with tools.
hc.start.3: Profile (top left) — goal, reminders, appearance, data.
hc.start.tip: The rhythm is weekly: a missed day resets nothing.
hc.songs.name: Songs
hc.songs.what: Everything for learning a song — in one card.
hc.songs.1: “+” — a song: key, tempo, lyrics with chords ([Am] before a syllable).
hc.songs.2: The card holds time, tempo chart and files; “Play” starts a session with the song.
hc.songs.tip: Chords in lyrics transpose to any key.
hc.session.name: Session
hc.session.what: A session: time runs, tools open as windows.
hc.session.1: Windows can be dragged and resized.
hc.session.2: Pause stops time; with no sound or touch the app asks whether practice goes on.
hc.session.3: “Finish” — progress, tempo and a note; the time goes to stats.
hc.session.tip: A short session every day beats one long one.
hc.calendar.name: Calendar
hc.calendar.1: “+” — an event: type, time, repeat, songs.
hc.calendar.2: An event’s songs are a set list that can be sent to the team.
hc.calendar.tip: Upcoming events show on home and in each song’s card.
hc.folder.name: Melete folder
hc.folder.what: A folder on the phone: all data visible in a file manager.
hc.folder.1: “Data and backups” → “Choose or create a folder”.
hc.folder.2: Data — a copy of all data; Media, Tabs, PDF, Lyrics — recordings, tabs, scores, lyrics.
hc.folder.3: Files dropped into the folder are sorted by the app; deleting from the folder deletes nothing in the app.
hc.folder.tip: On a new phone — “Restore data from the folder”.
hc.share.name: Team: send and receive
hc.share.what: Songs, tabs and set lists — to the team in one .melete file.
hc.share.2: A set list — from a calendar event.
hc.share.3: Receive — open the .melete file; songs update instead of duplicating.
hc.share.tip: Progress, tempo and practice time stay personal.
hc.melete.name: Melete and reminders
hc.melete.what: The mascot says a line of the day on home and reminds about practice.
hc.melete.what@n: A line of the day on home and practice reminders.
hc.melete.2: Practice times and addressing by name — in the same section.
hc.melete.3: No notifications — allow them in phone settings and press “Test”.
hc.melete.tip: No reminders on a practice day or from 22:00 to 8:00.

hc.owndata.what: Songs, quotes and profile — in one file that an AI chatbot can build.

hc.owndata.2: “Load a file” — the app shows the contents and asks what to accept.
hc.owndata.3: Practice hours and stats cannot be changed by a file.

wel.title: Melete — a musician’s companion
wel.p1: Melete helps to practise music regularly and calmly: practice tracking, songs and a calendar, a metronome, a tuner and other tools — in one app. The rhythm is weekly, with no pressure of daily streaks.
wel.p2: The app was created with Claude Code. It is completely free and open: the source code is distributed under the GPL-3.0 licence. No ads, subscriptions, accounts or data collection — everything stays on the device.
wel.p3: Melete was made for one purpose — to benefit musicians and to serve the good.
wel.legal: The app is provided “as is”, without warranties of any kind. To the extent permitted by applicable law, the developer is not responsible for how the app is used or for the materials added to it.
wel.accept: Tapping “Start” means agreement with the Terms of Use and the Privacy Policy.
